column1: # Every scripts/check-*.sh and scripts/verify-*.sh must be reachable from a
# .github/workflows entry point. A gate that is deliberately not wired is
# listed here as `scripts/<name>.sh<TAB><reason>`; the reason is mandatory and
# the entry is rejected once the gate becomes reachable, so this file cannot
# Prefer wiring the gate. An optional local tool belongs under a
# gate does not require to be reachable.

column2: Requires the explicitly pinned GNU binutils 2.47 oracle toolchain, which moving CI runners do not provision; pure checked-in goldens remain covered by cross-platform tests.
